Fictional outpatient letter | generated-002 | age 42
Consultation: 2025-02-01

The established diagnosis is focal epilepsy.

The patient reports staring seizures 2 to 4 times per month from 1 November 2024 through 1 February 2025. I regard these as epileptic.

A separate pattern of right-hand jerks is also epileptic. The patient reports 1 to 2 clusters per month, each containing 3 to 5 jerks, throughout the same period from 1 November 2024 through 1 February 2025.

Lamotrigine was proposed on 15 January 2025; this letter does not establish whether it has been started.

An EEG was requested on 10 January 2025. There is no result information in this letter.

Fictional outpatient letter | generated-002 | age 42
Consultation: 2025-07-15

The patient reports that both the same staring seizures and the separate right-hand jerks continued from 2 February through 15 July 2025: staring 2 to 4 times per month and jerks in 1 to 2 clusters per month of 3 to 5 jerks each. Both remain classified as epileptic.

The patient confirms never having taken lamotrigine at any time up to today, 15 July 2025; the January proposal was not enacted.
